content:
Backoffice context:
- Backoffice UI is in AIChatApp.Web/Components/Pages/Backoffice.razor.
- Backoffice API logic is mainly in AIChatApp.API/Controllers/BackofficeController.cs.
- Backoffice manages validation workflow, reported responses, prompt templates, knowledge entries, FAQs, profile management, user management, and Machine Learning tools.
- Prompt templates and knowledge entries edited in Backoffice override bundled JSON fallback content once published.
- Backoffice updates should invalidate assistant content cache through AssistantContentService.InvalidateProfileCache.
- Admin has full access. Validator has validation/backoffice access except user management and Machine Learning. User has chat-only access.
